description.value: Good Co. Granville is a lively bar and entertainment venue on Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, part of a four-location chain offering food, drinks, games, and sports viewing. The venue runs a packed calendar of regular events including salsa and bachata dance nights, music video bingo, trivia competitions, and live TV watch parties on a large LED screen. It is non-smoking throughout, wheelchair accessible, and accepts both credit and debit cards.
